[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/zkapi-types",
    "crates/zkapi-core",
    "crates/zkapi-proof",
    "crates/zkapi-client",
    "crates/zkapi-browser",
]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
version = "0.1.0"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
# Internal crates
zkapi-types  = { path = "crates/zkapi-types" }
zkapi-core   = { path = "crates/zkapi-core" }
zkapi-proof  = { path = "crates/zkapi-proof" }
zkapi-client = { path = "crates/zkapi-client" }

# Serialization
serde      = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"

# Encoding
hex = "0.4"
base64 = "0.22"

# Arkworks BN254 Groth16 and Baby-JubJub primitives
ark-ff  = "0.5"
ark-ec  = "0.5"
ark-std = "0.5"
ark-bn254 = "0.5"
ark-crypto-primitives = { version = "0.5", features = ["sponge", "r1cs", "snark"] }
ark-ed-on-bn254 = { version = "0.5", features = ["r1cs", "std"] }
ark-groth16 = "0.5"
ark-r1cs-std = "0.5"
ark-relations = "0.5"
ark-serialize = "0.5"
ark-snark = "0.5"

# Hashing
sha3 = "0.10"

# Randomness
rand = "0.8"

# HTTP
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json"] }

# Error handling
thiserror = "2.0"
anyhow    = "1.0"

# Identifiers
uuid = { version = "1.0", features = ["v4", "serde"] }

authors = ["Anza Maintainers <maintainers@anza.xyz>"]
build = false
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "Solana define_syscall macro and core syscall definitions."
homepage = "https://anza.xyz/"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/solana-define-syscall"
readme = false
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/anza-xyz/solana-sdk"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"]

[lib]
name = "solana_define_syscall"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
priority = 0
check-cfg = ['cfg(target_feature, values("static-syscalls"))']
